manifestations.description: Pain and cramp in his left ankle and foot when the weather changes
Residual shoulder pain and slightly decreased range of movement
Difficulty in heavy lifting and fast walking
Uncontrollable recurrent intrusive imagery of the accident
Fear of riding in private cars or taxis (travel not wholly avoided)
Occasional intrusive thoughts of harming his girlfriend (never acted upon)
Vulnerability to stress, tendency to develop obsessive and hypochondriacal thoughts, fluctuation of mental state when faced with stressors
Unable to manage Thai boxing, cycling or gym workout

treatments_received: Open reduction internal fixation surgery on left ankle with syndesmotic screw on 2012-09-17
Surgical removal of syndesmotic screw on 2012-11-16
Removal of remaining implants from left ankle on 2014-08-05
20 sessions of physiotherapy between 30 October 2012 and 3 June 2013
Orthopaedic follow-up care until discharge on 2014-08-20
Referral to Department of Psychiatry; first seen 9 January 2013; diagnosed and managed (drug-free observation initially)
Clinical psychology sessions (first seen 27 May 2013; last session 10 July 2013)
Commencement of Sertraline (low dose) from 27 October 2014 and ongoing psychiatric follow-up
Occupational therapy assessments (first out-patient session 9 April 2013; last assessment 10 May 2013)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
